_comment: Drop your own approved reaction images (PNG/JPG, square, face centred) in this folder and list them here. emotion = shocked | mind_blown | side_eye | crying_laughing | thinking | wait_what (or your own word). Only approved: true entries are used, and only by a scene event with "use_inbox": true. Same limits as the built-in faces: max 2 a video, 15 s apart, never on God or a serious/holy beat, under 1.5 s.
